fields.Name: T198 - Database Designer Column Sort
fields.Description: Exercises Database Designer's custom multi-field sort (OnSortChange toggling SortField/SortDirection with chevron rendering) — a hand-rolled table sort distinct from AG-Grid's column sort.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the Database Designer. Wait for the entity table to load (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). The table has clickable sortable column headers (Entity Name, Schema, Table, Owner, Created), each with a chevron sort indicator. Click a column header such as 'Entity Name' (or 'Schema'), then click the SAME header again. Success is that the row order changes when you click, an up/down chevron sort indicator appears on that column, and clicking the same header a second time flips the sort direction (ascending ↔ descending). Seeing the order change and the indicator flip is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Database Designer table has sortable column headers with sort-direction chevron indicators
Clicking a header reorders the rows and shows a sort indicator; clicking the same header again flips ascending/descending
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
